skill.summary: Comprehensive evaluation of incident response capabilities with maturity scoring and phase-based assessment framework.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the IR Readiness Assessment API.
- Enables comprehensive evaluation of incident response capabilities with maturity scoring and phase-based assessment framework.
- Provides endpoints for maturity assessment, phase definitions, and maturity level details.
- Delivers actionable summaries with strengths, gaps, and improvement recommendations aligned to industry standards (NIST, SANS, ISO 27035).
- Includes clear API usage instructions and pricing tiers.
